Front squat day — front squat + accessories, 9,335 kg
Deadlift day — barbell deadlift + accessories, 10,140 kg

en.eNote: No meals logged for Aug 20 – Aug 26 (last intake log: Jun 14), so the energy and burn charts assume the 2,000 kcal plan. Garmin active burn averaged ~488 kcal/day, up sharply from the ~387 of the Aug 25 board. Tuesday's deadlift day is the biggest day of the window at 771, Thursday's hack squat 741, Monday's swim 675, Friday's swim 614, Sunday's front squat 572, Saturday was the only true rest day at 45, and today reads 0 — nothing recorded yet this morning.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414 (today's Garmin BMR reads 642 because the day just started). Intake assumes 2,000 kcal all seven days (none logged after Jun 14), so the implied balance ≈ −902 kcal/day is exercise-driven, not measured — about 100 kcal/day deeper than the Aug 25 board. Tuesday alone implies ≈ −1,185, Thursday ≈ −1,155 and Monday ≈ −1,089.
en.wNote: Bridge shows the last logged meals (Jun 12–14) — no intake was logged for the displayed week. Negative balance = deficit.
en.i1t: Five sessions and only one rest day — the biggest week on this board
en.i1: 5 sessions across 5 active days, 5h 52m and ~3,418 active kcal, against 4 sessions, 4h 30m and ~2,710 kcal on the Aug 25 board. Tonnage jumped to 34,681 kg from 24,541. Thursday hack squat, Friday swim, Saturday rest, Sunday front squat, Monday swim, Tuesday deadlift, and nothing yet today — six of the last seven days carried work, and the only gap was Saturday. Tuesday was also the single hardest piece: effort 47 on 82 minutes at avg HR 123, the highest session effort of the window, ahead of Thursday's 43. The two swims remain the steady element — identical 2,225 m, 63 and 59 minutes, avg HR 130 and 131. Saturday was a clean rest day at 45 active kcal with max HR 98.
en.i2t: The hinge is back — as a barbell deadlift, not the trap bar
en.i2: Tuesday 13:00–14:22 on the watch — 82 minutes, 781 active kcal, avg HR 123, max 150; Hevy logs 56 minutes of working time inside that, 18 sets, 240 reps, 10,140 kg. It was built on the barbell deadlift: 60×6 at RPE 6, 100×6 at RPE 6, then 120×8 three times at RPE 8, 8.5 and 8.5, plus four sets of 24-rep walking lunge, machine chest press 63/70/77×12, lat pulldown 70×12×3 finishing at RPE 9, and dumbbell shoulder press 35×12×3. That is the same top set as the Aug 17 deadlift day (120×8×3) but 1,170 kg more total work, and this time every deadlift set carries an RPE. So the hinge pattern this board has been asking about for weeks is genuinely back — twice now, eight days apart. What it is not is the trap bar. Hevy logs it as "Deadlift (Barbell)", a different exercise from the "Deadlift (Trap bar)" behind the per-set HR chart, so that tracked gap stands at 67 days from Jun 20 and the chart gains no new point: its newest entry is still Thursday's hack squat (six sets, estimated peaks 117, 123, 130, 140, 136, 151, avg 120, still flagged uncertain). Goblet squat is now the oldest gap at 76 days from Jun 11.
en.i3t: Data quality: everything came through, and the sleep gate finally opened
en.i3: Hevy and Intervals.icu were both synced at the start of this refresh. Hevy holds full set-by-set data for all three lifting days, so 15,206 kg, 9,335 kg and 10,140 kg are measured rather than estimated, and Intervals had nothing new to add. Garmin recorded last night's sleep under calendar date Aug 26, which is what released the morning gate after it held the board at the Aug 25 snapshot. The Aug 23 and Aug 24 calendar dates are still permanently empty, so the Saturday-evening and Sunday-evening nights never existed as far as the chart is concerned and it still visibly jumps from Friday evening to Monday evening — but every night since Monday has been captured. Worth keeping: Tuesday's RPE logging. Aug 17's deadlift sets carry no RPE at all, which is why that session can only be read as tonnage; Tuesday's can be read as intent.
en.i4t: Recovery: the night after the deadlift was efficient but short and shallow
en.i4: Last night scored 78 on 6h 52m, lights out 23:08 and awake 06:12 — the earliest wake of the seven and 48 minutes later to bed than Monday, so 1h 08m shorter than the night before and 5 minutes under the 6h 57m average. Only 12 minutes awake, the least of any night here, for 97% efficiency. The soft spot is depth: 33 minutes of deep sleep, 8% of the night and the lowest of the seven, down from 50 on Monday and 86 under Friday 21's 119 — second consecutive night in the low band. REM held at 96 minutes. HRV at 38 is three under the 41 average and the lowest since Wednesday 19, the first dip that lines up cleanly with a hard session the day before. RHR held flat at 54. Overnight stress 17, lowest of the window; Body Battery charged 51. Readiness 74, good.
en.rec: Take the pool today. Yesterday's three sets of 120×8 at RPE 8.5 were the hardest work of the window, and the night behind them gave back only 33 minutes of deep sleep with HRV three under baseline — that is a normal, expected cost, not a warning, but it is not the profile for stacking a second heavy lift on top. The 2,225 m template is the right answer: 59–63 minutes, avg HR 130, nothing asked of the hinge or the quads, and it keeps the six-active-days-in-seven rhythm without adding load. Thursday, take the goblet squat. At 76 days it is now the oldest gap on the board, it is the cheapest of the three tracked lifts to run, and it would give the per-set HR chart its first clean point since Jun 20 — Thursday's hack-squat point is still an estimate flagged uncertain. Then, if the trap bar is going back into rotation, slot it Friday or Saturday and not before: two hinge days in nine is already a real dose, and a third inside a week is how the pattern gets abandoned again. Keep logging RPE the way Tuesday was logged — it is what turned that session from a tonnage number into readable information. On recovery, the one change worth making is bedtime. Your wake is pinned near 06:15, so bedtime is the only lever you have: 22:20 bought 8h 00m, 23:08 bought 6h 52m. Lights out by 22:40 tonight and hold it. Next: pool swim today, goblet squat Thursday, trap bar Friday or Saturday if at all, log every set with RPE, lights out by 22:40.

hr.eNote: Nema zabilježenih obroka za 20.–26.8. (zadnji unos: 14.6.), pa grafovi energije i potrošnje pretpostavljaju planskih 2.000 kcal. Garmin aktivna potrošnja prosječno ~488 kcal/dan, osjetno više od ~387 s ploče od 25.8. Utorkov dan mrtvog dizanja najveći je dan u prozoru sa 771, četvrtkov hack čučanj 741, ponedjeljkovo plivanje 675, petkovo 614, nedjeljni prednji čučanj 572, subota je bila jedini pravi dan odmora sa 45, a danas piše 0 — jutros još ništa nije zabilježeno.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414 (današnji Garminov BMR pokazuje 642 jer je dan tek počeo). Unos pretpostavlja 2.000 kcal svih sedam dana (ništa zabilježeno nakon 14.6.), pa je implicirana bilanca ≈ −902 kcal/dan posljedica treninga, a ne mjerena — oko 100 kcal/dan dublja nego na ploči od 25.8. Sam utorak implicira ≈ −1.185, četvrtak ≈ −1.155, a ponedjeljak ≈ −1.089.
hr.wNote: Most prikazuje zadnje zabilježene obroke (12.–14.6.) — za prikazani tjedan nema unosa. Negativna bilanca = deficit.
hr.i1t: Pet treninga i samo jedan dan odmora — najveći tjedan na ovoj ploči
hr.i1: 5 treninga kroz 5 aktivnih dana, 5h 52m i ~3.418 aktivnih kcal, naspram 4 treninga, 4h 30m i ~2.710 kcal na ploči od 25.8. Tonaža je skočila na 34.681 kg s 24.541. Četvrtak hack čučanj, petak bazen, subota odmor, nedjelja prednji čučanj, ponedjeljak bazen, utorak mrtvo dizanje, a danas još ništa — šest od zadnjih sedam dana nosilo je rad, a jedina praznina bila je subota. Utorak je ujedno bio najteži pojedinačni dio: napor 47 na 82 minute uz prosječni puls 123, najviši napor treninga u prozoru, ispred četvrtkovih 43. Dva plivanja ostaju stabilan element — istih 2.225 m, 63 i 59 minuta, prosječni puls 130 i 131. Subota je bila čist dan odmora sa 45 aktivnih kcal i maksimalnim pulsom 98.
hr.i2t: Pregib u kuku se vratio — kao mrtvo dizanje sa šipkom, ne s trap barom
hr.i2: Utorak od 13:00 do 14:22 na satu — 82 minute, 781 aktivnih kcal, prosjek 123, maksimum 150; Hevy unutar toga bilježi 56 minuta radnog vremena, 18 serija, 240 ponavljanja, 10.140 kg. Sve je bilo oslonjeno na mrtvo dizanje sa šipkom: 60×6 uz RPE 6, 100×6 uz RPE 6, pa tri puta 120×8 uz RPE 8, 8,5 i 8,5, uz četiri serije hodajućih iskoraka po 24 ponavljanja, potisak za prsa na spravi 63/70/77×12, lat mašinu 70×12×3 sa završetkom na RPE 9 i potisak za ramena bučicama 35×12×3. To je ista radna serija kao na danu mrtvog dizanja 17.8. (120×8×3), ali 1.170 kg više ukupnog rada, a ovaj put svaka serija mrtvog dizanja nosi RPE. Dakle, obrazac pregiba u kuku, o kojem ova ploča pita tjednima, doista se vratio — već dvaput, u razmaku od osam dana. Ono što to nije je trap bar. Hevy to bilježi kao "Deadlift (Barbell)", drugu vježbu od "Deadlift (Trap bar)" koja stoji iza grafa pulsa po serijama, pa ta praćena pauza iznosi 67 dana od 20.6., a graf ne dobiva novu točku: najnoviji unos ondje i dalje je četvrtkov hack čučanj (šest serija, procijenjeni vrhovi 117, 123, 130, 140, 136, 151, prosjek 120, i dalje označen kao nesiguran). Goblet čučanj sada je najstarija pauza sa 76 dana od 11.6.
hr.i3t: Kvaliteta podataka: sve je stiglo, a jutarnja provjera napokon se otvorila
hr.i3: Hevy i Intervals.icu sinkronizirani su na početku ovog osvježavanja. Hevy ima potpune podatke po serijama za sva tri dana dizanja, pa su 15.206 kg, 9.335 kg i 10.140 kg izmjereni, a ne procijenjeni, dok Intervals nije donio ništa novo. Garmin je sinoćnji san zabilježio pod kalendarskim datumom 26.8., što je otvorilo jutarnju provjeru nakon što je ona ploču držala na snimci od 25.8. Kalendarski datumi 23.8. i 24.8. i dalje su trajno prazni, pa noći od subote i nedjelje navečer za graf nikad nisu ni postojale i on i dalje vidljivo preskače s petkove večeri na ponedjeljkovu — ali svaka noć od ponedjeljka nadalje je zabilježena. Vrijedi zadržati: utorkovo bilježenje RPE-a. Serije mrtvog dizanja od 17.8. nemaju nijedan RPE, zbog čega se onaj trening može čitati samo kao tonaža; utorkov se može čitati kao namjera.
hr.i4t: Oporavak: noć nakon mrtvog dizanja bila je učinkovita, ali kratka i plitka
hr.i4: Sinoćnja noć ocijenjena je 78 uz 6h 52m, svjetlo u 23:08 i buđenje u 06:12 — najranije buđenje od sedam noći i 48 minuta kasnije lijeganje nego u ponedjeljak, pa 1h 08m kraće od prethodne noći i 5 minuta ispod prosjeka od 6h 57m. Svega 12 minuta budnosti, najmanje od svih noći ovdje, uz 97% učinkovitosti. Slaba točka je dubina: 33 minute dubokog sna, 8% noći i najniže od sedam, manje od ponedjeljkovih 50 i 86 ispod petkovih 119 — druga noć zaredom u niskom razredu. REM se održao na 96 minuta. HRV od 38 tri je ispod prosjeka od 41 i najniži od srijede 19., prvi pad koji se čisto poklapa s teškim treningom dan ranije. RHR je ostao na 54. Noćni stres 17, najniže u prozoru; Body Battery napunio se 51 bod. Spremnost 74, dobra.
hr.rec: Danas idi na bazen. Jučerašnje tri serije 120×8 uz RPE 8,5 bile su najteži rad u prozoru, a noć iza njih vratila je samo 33 minute dubokog sna uz HRV tri ispod osnovice — to je normalna, očekivana cijena, a ne upozorenje, ali nije profil za slaganje drugog teškog dizanja povrh toga. Predložak od 2.225 m pravi je odgovor: 59–63 minute, prosječni puls 130, ništa se ne traži od pregiba u kuku ni od kvadricepsa, a ritam od šest aktivnih dana u sedam ostaje netaknut bez dodatnog opterećenja. U četvrtak uzmi goblet čučanj. Sa 76 dana to je sada najstarija pauza na ploči, najjeftiniji je od tri praćena pokreta i dao bi grafu pulsa po serijama prvu čistu točku od 20.6. — četvrtkova točka za hack čučanj i dalje je procjena označena kao nesigurna. Zatim, ako se trap bar vraća u rotaciju, stavi ga u petak ili subotu, ne prije: dva dana pregiba u devet već je stvarna doza, a treći unutar tjedna način je na koji se obrazac opet napusti. Nastavi bilježiti RPE kako si bilježio u utorak — to je ono što je taj trening pretvorilo iz broja tonaže u čitljivu informaciju. Na strani oporavka, jedina promjena koju vrijedi napraviti je vrijeme lijeganja. Buđenje ti je prikovano oko 06:15, pa je lijeganje jedina poluga koju imaš: 22:20 je donijelo 8h 00m, a 23:08 je donijelo 6h 52m. Ugasi svjetlo do 22:40 večeras i zadrži to. Sljedeće: bazen danas, goblet čučanj u četvrtak, trap bar u petak ili subotu ako uopće, bilježi svaku seriju s RPE-om, svjetlo gasi do 22:40.
